question: Indiana finished a 16-0 season by beating Miami 27-21 in the January 2026 national title game. Which quarterback, a transfer from Georgia, started for the Hurricanes?
explanation: Beck spent his first college seasons at Georgia before moving to Miami for 2025, and his late heave was intercepted as Indiana held on for its first national championship.

question: Jalen Hurts came off the bench for an injured Tua Tagovailoa to rally Alabama past Georgia 35-28 in the December 2018 SEC Championship Game. Who caught his 10-yard touchdown pass that tied the game?
explanation: Hurts then won it himself on a 15-yard quarterback draw, a year after losing his starting job to Tagovailoa at halftime of the national title game.

question: Diego Pavia finished second in the 2025 Heisman voting at Vanderbilt. Which FBS program did he lead to a 10-win season and a Conference USA title game appearance in 2023?
explanation: Pavia began at New Mexico Military Institute, a junior college, then took New Mexico State to just its second 10-win season before transferring to Vanderbilt.

question: Texas A&M beat LSU 74-72 in seven overtimes in November 2018, the highest-scoring game in FBS history. Who quarterbacked the Aggies that night?
explanation: Mond threw six touchdown passes and found Kendrick Rogers for the two-point conversion that finally ended the game.

question: Army ended a 14-game losing streak to Navy with a 21-17 win in December 2016. Who was the Black Knights' quarterback?
explanation: Bradshaw completed just two passes but scored on a 9-yard run in the fourth quarter, ending the longest losing streak by either academy in a series dating to 1890.

question: In his final college game, Stetson Bennett led Georgia to a 65-7 rout of TCU in the January 2023 national title game. How many total touchdowns did he account for?
explanation: Bennett threw four touchdown passes and ran for two more in the most lopsided title game of the BCS and CFP eras.

question: Iowa State knocked No. 2 Oklahoma State out of the national title race with a 37-31 double-overtime win in November 2011. Which quarterback, playing only his fifth college game, led the Cyclones?
explanation: Running back Jeff Woody scored the winner on a 4-yard run in the second overtime to hand the Cowboys their first loss of 2011.

question: DeVonta Smith hurt his hand on the first pass thrown his way in the second half of Alabama's 52-24 win over Ohio State in the January 2021 national title game and never returned. How many receiving yards did he have in the first half?
explanation: Smith caught 12 passes for 215 yards and three touchdowns before halftime and was still named the game's offensive player of the game.

question: Which Indiana defensive back intercepted Carson Beck with 52 seconds left to seal the Hoosiers' 27-21 win over Miami in the January 2026 national title game?
explanation: It was Sharpe's first interception of the season, and it came after Fernando Mendoza's tackle-breaking 12-yard touchdown run on fourth-and-4 gave Indiana its cushion.

question: Washington held off Texas 37-31 in the January 2024 Sugar Bowl semifinal when Quinn Ewers' last-play pass to the back pylon fell incomplete. Who was the intended receiver?
explanation: Ewers rallied Texas into range in the final minute, but the Huskies held and advanced to their first College Football Playoff title game before losing to Michigan.
